interpretation: Biome assignments below are screening hypotheses from named forms/genera, not occurrence or suitability predictions. Urban planting can differ. An unassigned asset is unknown, not absent.

biomes.name: Tropical & Subtropical Moist Broadleaf Forests
biomes.gap: Palms and ornamentals do not substitute for diverse closed-canopy tropical hardwoods, lianas or epiphytes.

biomes.name: Tropical & Subtropical Dry Broadleaf Forests
biomes.gap: Few named dry-forest canopy genera or deciduous drought forms.

biomes.name: Tropical & Subtropical Coniferous Forests
biomes.gap: Generic pine silhouettes; regional pine architecture and broadleaf associates need matching.

biomes.name: Temperate Broadleaf & Mixed Forests
biomes.gap: Most varied named supply, but limited oak/maple age classes and understory diversity.

biomes.name: Temperate Conifer Forests
biomes.gap: Pines, spruce and redwoods provide forms; cedar/fir/hemlock coverage requires Workshop review.

biomes.name: Boreal Forests/Taiga
biomes.gap: Pine, spruce and birch forms; missing larch variation, dwarf woodland and wet understory.

biomes.name: Tropical & Subtropical Grasslands, Savannas & Shrublands
biomes.gap: Baobab and umbrella-thorn silhouettes help; regional grass/shrub mixes remain thin.

biomes.name: Temperate Grasslands, Savannas & Shrublands
biomes.gap: Generic grass/hedge fillers do not represent diverse prairie or steppe grasses and forbs.

biomes.name: Flooded Grasslands & Savannas
biomes.gap: Reeds and wetland structure are thin; distinguish living plants from tied-reed decoration.

biomes.name: Montane Grasslands & Shrublands
biomes.gap: Few low alpine/tussock forms; normal trees are not an alpine vegetation substitute.

biomes.name: Tundra
biomes.gap: No named dwarf willow/birch, sedge, moss/lichen palette established. Snowy tree prefabs are not tundra coverage.

biomes.name: Mediterranean Forests, Woodlands & Scrub
biomes.gap: Pine and evergreen oak can supply silhouettes; olive, cork oak and maquis diversity need Workshop review.

biomes.name: Deserts & Xeric Shrublands
biomes.gap: No named cactus/succulent or xeric shrub palette established from built-in names.

biomes.name: Mangroves
biomes.gap: No named built-in mangrove with prop/pneumatophore roots established.
